## DEV-65. What targeted clarification would settle the unresolved January 26 time and the resulting final-week goal status? Which already available administrative records would not resolve it?

- The conflict would be settled by asking one of the two clinicians who signed the January 26 individual psychotherapy note — Mira Patel, LCSW (primary record, signed 11:16) or Nora Ellis, LCSW (second record, signed 12:03) — to confirm the actual session start time: 09:00 (as the primary record states, giving 50 minutes) or 09:10 (as the second record states, giving 40 minutes). Both documents are final and of equal standing, so a direct attestation or a contemporaneous time-stamp (e.g., an EHR login log or room-entry record) from either clinician would resolve which start time is correct. *(not documented)* — HG-E115: [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:5-7](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L5-7), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:10](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L10), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:6-8](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L6-8); passage: [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:15-16](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L15-16), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:16-17](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L16-17)
- Resolving the start time would determine whether the January 26 session contributes 50 minutes (09:00 start) or 40 minutes (09:10 start) to the final week. The other two included visits that week contribute a fixed 75 minutes (January 29 group) and 30 minutes (January 30 family), totalling either 155 or 145 minutes against the 150-minute threshold. At 50 minutes the week total is 155 minutes — threshold met. At 40 minutes the total is 145 minutes — threshold not met. The 3-therapy-days threshold is met under either scenario (3 distinct days attended). Overall goal status is therefore met if the start time is 09:00, and not met if it is 09:10; it cannot be determined until the conflict is resolved. This is a partial week (Monday–Friday only). *(inference)* — HG-E115: [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:5-7](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L5-7), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:10](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L10), [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:5-7](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L5-7); HG-E118: [BH-D108_final_attendance_and_cancellation_register.txt:12](../documents/BH-D108_final_attendance_and_cancellation_register.txt#L12), [BH-D108_final_attendance_and_cancellation_register.txt:12](../documents/BH-D108_final_attendance_and_cancellation_register.txt#L12), [BH-D107_group_activity_records_2026-01-22_and_29.txt:12-15](../documents/BH-D107_group_activity_records_2026-01-22_and_29.txt#L12-15); HG-E119: [BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt:6-7](../documents/BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt#L6-7), [BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt:6-7](../documents/BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt#L6-7), [BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt:6-7](../documents/BH-D113_family_therapy_2026-01-30.txt#L6-7); passage: [signed_treatment_plan_jan05.txt:12](../documents/signed_treatment_plan_jan05.txt#L12)
- The two already-available administrative records — the appointment desk export and the early appointment status export — would not resolve the conflict. Both record the appointment as attended and show the scheduled slot, but neither captures the actual patient-contact start time; they cannot distinguish between 09:00 and 09:10. Similarly, the two final clinical notes (BH-D110 and BH-D111) are the very sources that disagree, so they cannot settle each other. — HG-E115: [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:3](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L3), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:4](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L4); passage: [early_appointment_status_export.txt:9](../documents/early_appointment_status_export.txt#L9), [BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt:15-16](../documents/BH-D110_individual_primary_record_2026-01-26.txt#L15-16), [BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt:16-17](../documents/BH-D111_individual_second_record_2026-01-26.txt#L16-17)
